proposals.evidence: The first chagala branch explicitly supplies Torwali čhāl, Bashkarik čhēl and Maiya ċael, alongside Prakrit chēla. The selected local vowel and aspiration variants match those named goat comparanda; both alternatives in the selected Maiya response belong to the same family. This exact regional evidence is stronger than a generic chāgala similarity, and other languages are not automatically included.
